doctrine_ref: Intent gate post-verbal negation scope (2026-10-25 fix): verb-final languages put negation AFTER the verb, including the polite ません form, which the old pattern lacked.
rationale: Japanese polite negation follows the verb (削除を依頼しません = do not request deletion). The old pattern covered しない/せず but not ません, so this read as a deletion request. Post-verbal scope including ません must catch it: NOT_APPLICABLE with zero deletion steps.
request_summary: Synthetic subject, Japanese: do not request complete deletion of the account related to this email. No records exist in the bundle; the verdict hinges on intent alone.
title: Japanese polite post-verbal negation: do not request deletion
